The Brain & Performance Centre

The Journey Forward

A brand film following one family's route through the centre's assessment and treatment pathway — told through a mother's voice, from first consultation to steps of progress in the park.

Runtime
≈ 100 sec
Scenes
9
Shots
34
Style
Realistic
braindubai

Scene 01

Modern Therapy Center

4 shots

The facility is bright, filled with natural light and warm wooden accents.

AURELIA (40s, an American living in London, her accent a soft blend of both) pushes a specialized wheelchair. In it sits ELARA (8), a bright-eyed girl with cerebral palsy. Elara wears colorful leg braces and holds a stuffed lemur.

Aurelia looks directly at the camera. Her expression is one of tired but resilient hope.

AURELIA · line 1

“Every child with cerebral palsy has different strengths, different challenges—and different possibilities.”

CUT TO

Assessment Room

Consultation Room

“And we will always be honest. If we do not believe our programme is right for your child, we will tell you.”
